_comment: Wikimedia Commons candidates per puzzle, best first. 'File:' = a specific file, 'Category:' = search that category (largest suitable file wins). tool/fetch_photos.dart checks the licence of each file through the Commons API and only accepts CC0, public domain, CC BY and CC BY-SA. Candidates were found by web search on 2026-10-05; the licence check happens at fetch time. Re-mapped 2026-10-05 after visual check: y07's earlier pick (a statue in Andhra Pradesh) and an idol-centred pili vesha photo were rejected. No Commons photos exist yet for a hasyagara or a tala-maddale session; those use the closest Yakshagana photos until AI or commissioned art replaces them.
